counterfactual.change: set gravity from 9.81 to 0, keeping all else identical (same 4 steps); free-flight energy stays exactly constant so no energy_bound violation, proving gravity integration during high-speed substepping causes the growth

explanation: Single body in free fall (no walls, no contacts, controller disabled with work 0). Gravity accelerates vy from -38.95 to -43.99 while vx is constant, but total energy rises monotonically 1656.8->1698.3->1741.2->1785.3->1830.77, exceeding allowed 1827.5 at step 4. KE gain (~208J) far exceeds PE loss (~35J). The run uses ~41-43 substeps per step due to high speed (~57-60). Gravity integration over substeps thus adds spurious energy instead of conserving E=KE+mgh. Zero-gravity counterfactual conserves energy exactly, confirming gravity/substep interaction as cause.
vision_note: A single blue circle moves steadily down and to the right through empty space with no walls, contacts, or waypoints visible. Nothing collides or penetrates; it simply free-falls with apparently normal gravitational acceleration.
